payload.friendly_name: A live console: the hub working, and each agent's own page
payload.purpose_context: Closes #46 and #51 (which absorbed #22). The console polls nothing: it holds one upstream SSE connection to the hub and re-emits on its own origin, so connect-src 'self' stands and N operators cost the hub one listener. Design is settled and reviewed by the owner. New API surface is required: a hub-wide event stream and snapshot, and an observed outbox route, which does not exist today — /actors/{name}/outbox is a POST for sending, and neither house.py nor mailbox.py has any sent-side query.
payload.purpose_tldr: One held connection feeds a hub-wide Realtime tab and an agent's own page, which absorbs /mailbox/{name} and shows identity, provenance-labelled profile facts, and mail in both directions.
